title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 6,101–6,150 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 探索外星地外生命起源之太空生物學

examples.en: Astrobiology investigates whether microbial life once flourished in ancient Martian lakebed sediments.
examples.zh: 太空生物學，深入研究微生物生命是否曾繁衍於遠古火星湖床沉積物中。

examples.en: Leading research universities now offer dedicated degrees in interplanetary astrobiology.
examples.zh: 頂尖研究型大學如今紛紛設立了行星際太空生物學專屬碩博士學位課程。

examples.en: Exploring subsurface hydrothermal vents on Earth provides crucial analog data for modern astrobiology.
examples.zh: 探索地球深海海底熱泉極端生態系，為現代太空生物學尋找地外生命提供了寶貴的類比參照。

words.definition: 金髮女孩適居帶 (液態水存在) 的；適合居住的

examples.en: Orbiting inside the circumstellar habitable zone allows liquid water to pool stably on exoplanet surfaces.
examples.zh: 位於恆星周圍的黃金適居帶，讓液態水能穩定匯聚在系外行星表面。

examples.en: Planetary scientists analyze stellar radiation to confirm whether an Earth-sized world is truly habitable.
examples.zh: 行星科學家仔細分析恆星的高能輻射通量，以確認這顆類地行星是否真正具備適居條件。

examples.en: Leaving our crowded planet to settle habitable off-world colonies remains a defining goal of the space age.
examples.zh: 走出擁擠的母星地球、前往其他適居天體建立永久定居點，是整個太空探索時代最明確的長遠目標。

words.definition: 地外行星大氣生命跡象特徵氣體指標

examples.en: Detecting simultaneous traces of methane and oxygen in the exoplanet's sky suggests a potential biosignature.
examples.zh: 在系外行星大氣中同時探測到甲烷與氧氣共存，代表著強烈的潛在生命特徵跡象。

examples.en: The search for a genuine atmospheric biosignature requires ruling out abiotic volcanic emissions.
examples.zh: 嚴格求證真正的行星大氣生命跡象特徵，首要任務是徹底排除火山非生物地質活動的干擾釋放。

examples.en: Spectroscopic discovery of dimethyl sulfide in alien atmospheres would represent an astonishing biosignature.
examples.zh: 若光譜儀在外星大氣中探測到二甲基硫醚分子譜線，將會是震撼全球天文界的劃時代生命特徵發現。

words.definition: 嗜極生物 (抗輻射耐極溫微生物)

examples.en: Hardy microscopic extremophiles survive extreme vacuum, freezing cold, and lethal ultraviolet radiation in space.
examples.zh: 強悍的嗜極微生物，能在太空極端高真空、冰點低溫與致命紫外線下存活。

examples.en: Studying how an extremophile repairs its DNA after ionizing radiation sheds light on human longevity.
examples.zh: 深入研究微小嗜極生物在遭受游離輻射轟擊後如何自我修復 DNA，為人類抗衰老與長壽帶來曙光。

examples.en: Researchers sample boiling sulfur hot springs to discover resilient extremophile bacteria.
examples.zh: 跨國科學家親赴滾燙的黃石硫磺沸騰溫泉中取樣，尋找具備神奇修復特性的抗逆嗜極細菌。

words.definition: 火星與月球表面玄武岩風化土壤碎屑層

examples.en: Sintering native Martian regolith with concentrated microwaves creates sturdy bricks for habitat construction.
examples.zh: 用聚焦微波燒結火星當地的風化層土壤，能燒製出興建火星基地防護牆的堅固磚塊。

examples.en: The sharp, abrasive nature of lunar regolith poses severe mechanical hazards to rover wheels and spacesuit seals.
examples.zh: 月球表面銳利如碎玻璃的玄武岩風化土壤碎屑，對探測車輪胎與太空衣密封接縫構成嚴峻的磨損威脅。

examples.en: Extracting trapped oxygen and water ice from polar lunar regolith is vital for sustainable off-world settlements.
examples.zh: 從月球極地風化土層中提取封存的原生氧氣與水冰，是維繫外星永久定居點自給自足的生命線。

words.definition: 行星地球化改造工程 (釋放氣體增溫增壓)

examples.en: Theoretical planetary terraforming involves vaporizing south polar ice caps to thicken the Martian atmosphere.
examples.zh: 行星地球化改造工程構想，透過蒸發火星極地冰冠來增厚大氣層並引發溫室效應。

examples.en: Genetically modified cyanobacteria could be deployed to begin early biological stages of terraforming.
examples.zh: 透過基因工程改造的高效藍綠菌，可作為行星先驅生物投放至火星地表，啟動早期的生物地球化。

examples.en: Complete planetary terraforming would span hundreds of generations, transforming frozen red deserts into blue oceans.
examples.zh: 完整的火星地球化改造工程將歷經數百代人的不懈接力，最終將冰冷的紅色荒漠轉化為碧海藍天。

words.definition: 毅力號核動力火星表面探測漫遊車；漫遊者

examples.en: The autonomous nuclear-powered rover navigated autonomously across rocky dunes using AI hazard avoidance.
examples.zh: 搭載核動力電池的自主火星漫遊車，利用 AI 避障演算法在崎嶇沙丘間精準巡航。

examples.en: Armed with robotic arms, laser spectrometers, and drill bits, the scientific rover samples Martian bedrock.
examples.zh: 配備多關節機械手臂、雷射誘發光譜儀與鑽探岩芯鑽頭，這輛全地形科考漫遊車深入鑽探火星基岩。

examples.en: Engineers cheered wildly when the six-wheeled rover sent back its first high-definition panoramic postcard.
examples.zh: 當這台六輪火星探測車從億萬公里外傳回第一張超高解析度的全景地貌明信片時，工程師們熱烈歡呼。

words.definition: 火星密封岩芯樣本採樣返回地球計畫；樣品

examples.en: The Mars Sample Return campaign aims to bring pristine rock cores back to Earth for ultra-precise lab testing.
examples.zh: 火星樣本採樣返回計畫，旨在將密封的原始岩芯帶回地球進行頂級化驗。

examples.en: Titanium sample tubes are dropped along the rover’s path, waiting for a future retrieval lander.
examples.zh: 封存著沉積岩芯的純鈦樣本儲存管被整齊放置在探測車行經路徑上，靜候未來的取樣登陸器前來回收。

examples.en: Analyzing a tiny soil sample using synchrotron radiation could reveal definitive proof of past alien microbiology.
examples.zh: 使用同步輻射光源化驗微小的火星土壤樣本，將能為火星遠古是否存在地外微生物提供決定性鐵證。

words.definition: 火星土壤有毒高氯酸鹽化學物

examples.en: Washing toxic perchlorate salts out of red dirt is an essential prerequisite before growing greenhouse crops.
examples.zh: 在溫室種植太空蔬菜前，必須先以化學方法洗除火星紅土中殘留的有毒高氯酸鹽。

examples.en: Specialized bioremediation bacteria have been engineered to convert dangerous soil perchlorate into harmless chloride and oxygen.
examples.zh: 特化的生物降解菌株經過基因編輯，能將土壤中具氧化毒性的高氯酸鹽高效率分解為無害的氯化物與純氧。

examples.en: Martian perchlorate dust clinging to spacesuits must be decontaminated in the airlock to protect crew lungs.
examples.zh: 附著在太空防護衣表面的火星高氯酸鹽粉塵，必須在氣閘艙內徹底洗消，以防吸入損傷組員呼吸道。

words.definition: 太空站無土無重力水耕蔬果栽培系統

examples.en: Closed-loop LED hydroponics supplies astronauts with fresh crisp lettuce, crunchy radishes, and sweet strawberries.
examples.zh: 閉環式 LED 水耕栽培系統，為駐站太空人源源不絕供應新鮮生菜、水蘿蔔與草莓。

examples.en: Nutrient-rich water mist delivered through automated hydroponics nourishes plant roots without needing any soil.
examples.zh: 透過微電腦自動化水耕噴霧系統輸送的微量元素營養液，能在完全無需泥土的情況下滋養作物根系。

examples.en: Expanding orbital hydroponics facilities will reduce the expensive cargo mass required for deep-space resupply flights.
examples.zh: 大規模擴展軌道水耕溫室農場，能大幅削減由地球發射的長途深空補給貨運飛船所伴隨的昂貴載荷重量。

words.definition: 環控與生命維持系統 (ECLSS 98% 水循環)；支援

examples.en: The space station’s environmental control and life support system recycles 98% of all astronaut wastewater.
examples.zh: 太空站搭載的環境控制與生命維持系統，能將 98% 廢水循環再生。

examples.en: Modern life support infrastructure maintains cabin atmospheric pressure, oxygen levels, and humidity balance continuously.
examples.zh: 現代生命維持系統全天候維持太空艙內部大氣壓力穩定、精確配比氧氣濃度並嚴密調節濕度平衡。

examples.en: Redundant backup scrubbing canisters ensure life support never halts even during electrical bus overhauls.
examples.zh: 雙軌並行的備用二氧化碳吸收濾罐，確保即便在主供電匯流排檢修期間，生命維持循環也絕不停擺。

words.definition: 薩巴捷反應器 (將呼出 CO2 轉化為水)；反應爐

examples.en: The Sabatier reactor combines exhaled carbon dioxide with hydrogen to manufacture water and methane fuel.
examples.zh: 薩巴捷化學反應器，將太空人呼出的二氧化碳與氫氣結合製造出純水與甲烷燃料。

examples.en: Running the nickel catalyst reactor at four hundred degrees achieves ninety-five percent carbon recovery efficiency.
examples.zh: 在攝氏四百度高溫下運轉的鎳觸媒反應器，在太空封閉系統中展現高達百分之九十五的碳回收轉化率。

examples.en: Integrating a Sabatier reactor into the Martian return vehicle allows astronauts to synthesize their own rocket propellant on-site.
examples.zh: 將薩巴捷化學反應器整合進火星返回載具中，能讓太空人就地取材自產返回地球所需的液態甲烷火箭推進劑。

words.definition: 質子交換膜純水電解製氧系統

examples.en: Oxygen generators split recycled water molecules via proton-exchange membrane electrolysis continuously.
examples.zh: 產氧機透過高效率質子交換膜電解水技術，二十四小時不間斷分解純水產生氧氣。

examples.en: Powered by solar arrays, water electrolysis provides breathable oxygen while releasing hydrogen into the Sabatier loop.
examples.zh: 由太陽能電池翼供電的水電解製氧模組，在產出可供呼吸的純氧之同時，釋放副產物氫氣注入薩巴捷循環。

examples.en: Perfecting high-pressure steam electrolysis generates rocket oxidizer directly from melted Martian subsurface glacial ice.
examples.zh: 完善高壓水蒸氣電解技術，能直接將融化的火星地下冰川轉化為液氧火箭氧化劑，實現就地能源自給。

words.definition: 尿液真空離心旋轉蒸餾淨化純水系統

examples.en: Vacuum rotary distillation purifies astronaut urine into drinking water purer than municipal tap supplies.
examples.zh: 真空旋轉蒸餾淨化系統，將太空人尿液轉化為比市售自來水還要純淨百倍的甘甜飲用水。

examples.en: Centrifugal forces inside the distillation chamber substitute for gravity, separating boiling vapor from heavy brine.
examples.zh: 蒸餾離心艙內部的高速旋轉離心力完美替代了重力，在真空微重力環境下高效率分離沸騰水蒸氣與濃縮鹽水。

examples.en: The station's urine distillation processor has successfully produced thousands of liters of clean recycled water.
examples.zh: 太空站搭載的尿液蒸餾處理器已順利運轉數年，累計產出了數千公升純淨無瑕的再生水供組員飲用。

words.definition: 深空致命宇宙射線與太陽耀斑高能輻射

examples.en: Deep-space voyagers face dangerous galactic cosmic radiation capable of damaging human DNA cells.
examples.zh: 長途深空遠航的探險家，面臨著能穿透金屬並破壞人體 DNA 細胞的致命銀河宇宙射線。

examples.en: Solar storm shelters built inside the spacecraft's water tanks shield crew members from lethal flare radiation.
examples.zh: 巧妙安置在太空船水箱環繞核心的太陽風暴應急避難艙，能在太陽耀斑爆發時保護組員免遭致命輻射滅頂。

examples.en: Cumulative radiation exposure limits dictate how many months an astronaut can safely reside in interplanetary space.
examples.zh: 嚴格的終身累積輻射暴露安全上限，精準規範了每位太空人在行星際深空中所能停留的安全月數極限。

words.definition: 地下熔岩洞穴厚重天然防輻射屏障

examples.en: Stacking two meters of native soil above habitats provides dense polyethylene and water radiation shielding.
examples.zh: 在居住艙上方覆蓋兩公尺厚的玄武岩土層，能形成堅不可摧的天然防輻射屏障。

examples.en: Hydrogen-rich materials like water and plastic foam offer superior neutron radiation shielding compared to heavy metals.
examples.zh: 富含氫原子的水、聚乙烯與塑膠發泡材料，在阻擋快中子與宇宙射線的防護效能上遠勝沉重的鉛板。

examples.en: Active magnetic shielding systems generate artificial magnetospheres around spaceships to deflect incoming solar protons.
examples.zh: 主動式電磁防護罩系統能在太空船外圍張開人造人工磁層，在遠洋深空中將高速太陽質子流彈開偏轉。

words.definition: 火星地下龐大天然火山熔岩洞穴通道；管子

examples.en: Underground lava tubes span fifty meters wide, providing ready-made caverns shielded from surface micrometeorites.
examples.zh: 火星地下寬達五十公尺的火山熔岩洞穴通道，是隔絕地表微隕石撞擊的現成地下基地。

examples.en: Thermal imaging cameras discovered openings leading into massive subsurface lava tube networks.
examples.zh: 軌道探測器的紅外線熱顯像儀，在火山斜坡邊緣發現了數個直通地下龐大熔岩管網系統的天窗開口。

examples.en: Inflatable habitat modules can be expanded inside a deep lava tube to create a permanent underground settlement.
examples.zh: 將充氣式模組化居住艙運送進深層熔岩洞穴中展開組裝，能建構出不受沙塵暴侵擾的永久性地下城。

words.definition: 充氣式高強度克維拉行星居住艙穹頂；棲息地

examples.en: The multi-layered inflatable habitat dome expanded to triple its packed rocket fairing volume within hours.
examples.zh: 充氣式行星居住艙穹頂，在抵達著陸點數小時內即可充氣膨脹至發射體積的三倍大。

examples.en: Life inside the planetary habitat is designed with simulated sunlight and green plants to support psychological health.
examples.zh: 行星表面居住艙內部融入了高擬真晝夜節律陽光與綠化水耕植生牆，全面呵護科考隊員的心理健康。

examples.en: Pressure bulkheads segment the surface habitat so that any puncture can be isolated in seconds.
examples.zh: 堅固的防爆加壓水密隔艙壁將地表居住基地細分為獨立單元，能在遭遇微隕石穿刺時於數秒內緊急氣密隔離。

words.definition: 太空人走出氣閘之艙外漫步活動 (EVA)；活動

examples.en: Astronauts rehearsed emergency drills for seven-hour extravehicular activity (EVA) spacewalks.
examples.zh: 太空人針對長達七個小時的艙外活動漫步，在水槽中進行了上百次模擬演練。

examples.en: Stepping out through the hatch during extravehicular activity requires double-checking every suit seal.
examples.zh: 跨出氣閘艙門執行艙外活動漫步前，兩位太空人必須相互進行上百道嚴格的防護衣氣密雙重覆核。

examples.en: Autonomous robotic assistants accompany explorers during surface planetary activity to carry heavy geology drills.
examples.zh: 自主型伴隨輪式機器人在探險隊員執行地表科考活動時如影隨形，主動扛起沉重的重型地質鑽探機具。

words.definition: 高靈活關節行星加壓探索太空防護衣

examples.en: The modern lunar spacesuit features flexible bearing joints that allow geologists to kneel and collect rocks easily.
examples.zh: 新一代登月太空防護衣配備高靈活萬向軸承關節，讓地質學家能靈活下跪採集標本。

examples.en: The multi-layered spacesuit functions as a miniature personal spacecraft, regulating thermal balance and oxygen.
examples.zh: 複合多層結構的艙外太空防護衣本質上是一艘微型載人太空船，自主調控純氧供應、恆溫冷卻與生命維持。

examples.en: Rear-entry hatches on advanced spacesuits eliminate the chore of pulling bulky pants up inside tight cabins.
examples.zh: 新世代探索太空衣採用後背式快開穿脫氣閘艙口設計，免除了在狹窄加壓艙內費力套穿臃腫褲管的苦惱。

words.definition: 鍍純金防強光防紫外線太空頭盔面罩

examples.en: A paper-thin vapor-deposited layer of pure 24-karat gold coats the helmet visor to reflect blinding sunlight.
examples.zh: 太空人頭盔面罩表面鍍上一層奈米級純金薄膜，能反射外太空中毫無大氣過濾的刺眼陽光。

examples.en: The astronaut pulled down the tinted outer visor as the rising sun flared brilliantly over the airless horizon.
examples.zh: 當沒有大氣散射的耀眼烈日從無大氣天際線噴薄升起時，太空人迅速拉下了外層深色純金遮光面罩。

examples.en: Anti-fog coatings applied to the inside of the clear polycarbonate visor maintain crystal-clear visibility.
examples.zh: 塗布在聚碳酸酯透明面罩內側的先進長效防霧塗層，能防止太空人呼吸水氣凝結，始終保持視野透亮。

words.definition: 太空人緊急自救噴氣背包微型推進器

examples.en: If an astronaut accidentally drifts untethered, the automated nitrogen jetpack maneuvers them back to safety.
examples.zh: 若太空人意外脫鉤飄離太空站，高壓氮氣自救噴氣背包會自動點火將其安全推回艙門口。

examples.en: The simplified emergency jetpack is fitted directly to the life support backpack on all spacewalk missions.
examples.zh: 這款名為 SAFER 的緊湊型緊急自救噴氣背包，直接掛載於所有出艙漫步太空人的生命維持背包底部。

examples.en: Cold-gas nitrogen thrusters inside the jetpack provide small, precise bursts to arrest spin and orientation.
examples.zh: 噴氣背包內建的冷氣高壓氮氣微型推力器，透過精密點火噴射制動翻滾，精確修正太空人漂移姿態。

words.definition: 防漂移防脫鉤高強度克維拉太空安全繫繩

examples.en: Clipping a braided steel wire tether to the station handrail prevents floating helplessly away into the void.
examples.zh: 將高強度編織安全繫繩牢牢扣在太空站外側扶手上，能徹底防止太空人意外漂入太空深淵。

examples.en: Retractable spool tethers keep heavy tools anchored to the spacesuit so wrenches do not become orbital debris.
examples.zh: 自動回收式彈簧工具繫繩將重型扳手牢牢鎖定在太空衣胸前，防止工具脫手飛散成為危險的太空垃圾。

examples.en: Always verify that your safety tether carabiner is fully locked before releasing your hands from the ladder.
examples.zh: 在雙手完全放開外艙攀爬金屬階梯之前，務必再次用手撫摸確認安全繫繩扣環已百分之百鎖死卡定。

words.definition: 長期太空漫遊微重力失重環境狀態

examples.en: Long-term exposure to orbital microgravity redistributes bodily fluids toward the upper torso and head.
examples.zh: 長期處於軌道微重力失重環境，會使人體體液往上半身與頭部集中，引發太空臉腫脹。

examples.en: Growing protein crystals in microgravity produces near-flawless structures that reveal drug target details.
examples.zh: 在微重力失重條件下生長的高純度蛋白質單晶結構近乎完美無瑕，能精準揭示新藥研發的分子標靶細節。

examples.en: Astronauts must relearn everyday motor skills to adapt to floating inside a continuous microgravity environment.
examples.zh: 初抵太空軌道的太空人必須重新學習最基礎的肢體協調平衡，以從容適應在微重力無重力環境中漂浮穿行。

words.definition: 太空人骨骼肌肉失重萎縮退化；萎縮

examples.en: Rigorous daily resistance workouts combat rapid bone demineralization and calf muscle atrophy in zero-g.
examples.zh: 每天堅持高強度阻力重訓，是為了對抗無重力環境下快速發生的骨質流失與小腿肌肉萎縮。

examples.en: Without the constant resistance of Earth's gravity, postural back muscles begin to atrophy within weeks.
examples.zh: 由於徹底擺脫了地球一重力環境下的日常對抗負載，人體深層脊椎核心肌群會在數週內悄然萎縮退化。

examples.en: Dietary supplements rich in amino acids and calcium help slow down muscular atrophy on long missions.
examples.zh: 富含必需氨基酸、維生素 D 與高純度活性鈣的太空專用機能口糧，能有效延緩長途星際遠征中的肌肉萎縮。

words.definition: 每日兩小時重力負壓阻力健身束帶；束縛

examples.en: Bungee harnesses strap runners firmly onto treadmill belts so their feet do not bounce off the track.
examples.zh: 彈性高拉力束縛吊帶將太空人牢牢固定在太空跑步機上，確保每一步踏下皆有足夠阻力。

examples.en: Tightening the padded harness ensures realistic resistance loads are applied across the hips and spine.
examples.zh: 調緊帶有厚實軟墊的負壓健身吊帶，能將模擬地球重力的衝擊承重平均分散至太空人的髖關節與脊椎柱。

examples.en: Two hours of mandatory exercise strapped into the gym harness is scheduled into every astronaut’s calendar.
examples.zh: 每天強制穿戴束縛吊帶在跑步機與阻力器上揮汗鍛鍊兩個小時，是太空人每日排程表上不可妥協的必修課。

words.definition: 旋轉式人工重力離心機太空艙；離心機

examples.en: Sleeping inside a spinning artificial gravity centrifuge helps human circulatory systems stay Earth-adapted.
examples.zh: 夜間睡在緩慢旋轉的人工重力離心機太空艙中，能幫助人體心血管系統維持適應地球重力。

examples.en: The research station tested a human-rated centrifuge to evaluate optimal rotation speeds and radii.
examples.zh: 太空前瞻實驗艙正在全面測試載人人體離心機，以深入評估人工重力艙的最佳旋轉角速度與迴轉半徑。

examples.en: Generating one-third Earth gravity via a slow-revolving centrifuge eliminates the nauseating effects of Coriolis motion.
examples.zh: 透過大型慢速旋轉離心艙模擬出三分之一地球重力，能有效消除引發劇烈暈眩嘔吐的科氏力前庭錯覺。

words.definition: 霍曼轉移地火最短能源消耗軌道航線

examples.en: Spacecraft follow an elliptical Hohmann transfer trajectory that intersects Mars with minimal rocket propellant.
examples.zh: 太空船遵循優雅的霍曼轉移軌道，以最低的燃料消耗精準切入火星交會軌道。

examples.en: Mid-course correction burns ensure the probe stays locked onto its precise interplanetary trajectory.
examples.zh: 在長達數月寂靜的深空巡航中進行數次中途微調點火修正，確保探測器緊緊鎖定既定的行星際飛行航線。

examples.en: Calculating the gravitational assist trajectory around Jupiter boosted the Voyager probe out of the solar system.
examples.zh: 藉由精密計算繞行木星的大質量重力彈弓助推軌道，成功將航海家號探測器加速甩出太陽系奔向群星。

words.definition: 每二十六個月開啟一次的地火發射窗口；窗戶

examples.en: The planetary launch window opens every twenty-six months when Earth and Mars align favorably in orbit.
examples.zh: 當地球與火星在公轉軌道上運行至最佳相對位置時，每二十六個月才會開啟一次寶貴的發射窗口。

examples.en: Missing the tight launch window forces flight planners to postpone interplanetary missions by two full years.
examples.zh: 萬一因天氣或技術故障錯過這短短兩週的發射窗口，整個火星探測計畫將被迫整整延宕兩年之久。

examples.en: Propulsion engineers calculated an optimal departure window to take full advantage of orbital alignment.
examples.zh: 火箭軌道工程師精算出能量消耗最低的最佳出發窗口，以極致利用兩顆行星公轉軌道的幾何交會紅利。

words.definition: 核熱火箭 (NTR) 與電漿推進科技；推進力

examples.en: Advanced nuclear thermal propulsion could cut interplanetary transit durations from nine months to ninety days.
examples.zh: 先進的核熱火箭推進技術，能將漫長的地火星際航程從九個月大幅縮減至短短九十天。

examples.en: Electric plasma propulsion provides phenomenal fuel efficiency for long-duration deep-space exploratory voyages.
examples.zh: 磁電漿引擎超高比沖推進科技，為長達數年之久的無人深空科學探勘遠航提供了超乎想像的極致燃油效率。

examples.en: Space agencies are funding next-generation fusion propulsion concepts to make crewed Mars journeys routine.
examples.zh: 各國太空總署投入數十億巨資研發次世代受控核融合星際推進概念，力圖讓載人火星往返成為家常便飯。

words.definition: 氙氣離子霍爾推進超高比沖引擎；發動機

examples.en: The blue-glowing xenon ion engine produces gentle, continuous thrust for years using solar electricity.
examples.zh: 散發幽藍光芒的氙氣離子引擎，利用太陽能電力提供持續數年不絕的微小穩定推力。

examples.en: Multiple Hall-effect thruster engines fired in sequence to steer the robotic asteroid redirect spacecraft.
examples.zh: 多具霍爾效應離子推進引擎依序輪流點火，穩健牽引著重達數十噸的無人小行星攔截探測飛船。

examples.en: Operating the high-efficiency ion engine requires only a few grams of inert noble gas per day.
examples.zh: 運轉這具效率驚人的超高比沖離子發動機，每天僅僅需要耗費幾公克惰性無毒的純氙氣氣體。

words.definition: 引擎燃料燃燒效率比沖 (Specific Impulse)

examples.en: High specific impulse ratings mean ion drives generate exceptional velocity changes per kilogram of fuel.
examples.zh: 超高的比沖效率，代表離子引擎每消耗一公斤燃料就能帶來極其驚人的速度增益。

examples.en: Liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen chemical engines offer high thrust but modest specific impulse values.
examples.zh: 傳統液氫與液氧低溫化學火箭引擎能爆發出排山倒海的龐大推力，但其比沖燃料能效數值相對有限。

examples.en: Maximizing specific impulse allows interplanetary ships to pack more scientific payload instead of propellant mass.
examples.zh: 將星際發動機的比沖性能推升至極致，能讓深空飛船省下龐大的燃料自重，轉而搭載更多頂級科學儀器。

words.definition: 火星稀薄大氣層摩擦氣動減速入軌工藝

examples.en: The orbiter performed repeated gentle aerobraking passes through upper Martian air to circularize its orbit.
examples.zh: 軌道探測器多次掠過火星高層稀薄大氣層進行大氣氣動減速，逐步將橢圓軌道修正為圓軌道。

examples.en: Aerobraking uses natural atmospheric drag to slow down the spacecraft, saving thousands of kilograms of rocket fuel.
examples.zh: 巧妙善用外星大氣摩擦阻力的大氣氣動減速工法，為探測器省下了數千公斤極其珍貴的制動反推火箭燃料。

examples.en: Flight controllers closely monitor thermal sensors on the solar panels during high-speed aerobraking dips.
examples.zh: 地面飛控工程師在飛船高速扎入大氣層進行氣動減速俯衝時，屏氣凝神緊盯太陽能電池翼上的溫度感測讀數。

words.definition: 燒蝕型高溫陶瓷防熱盾 (抵禦兩千度摩擦)

examples.en: The composite ablative heatshield glowed white-hot as it absorbed the inferno of high-speed re-entry.
examples.zh: 複合式燒蝕型防熱盾在承受高達兩千度劇烈摩擦熱流時發出耀眼白光，保護內部設備。

examples.en: Tiles of ultra-high-temperature ceramic make up the blunt heatshield that protects the crew capsule.
examples.zh: 由航太級超高溫耐火陶瓷隔熱瓦拼嵌而成的鈍型防熱盾，築起守護載人太空加壓艙的唯一保命屏障。

examples.en: Technicians inspect every inch of the heatshield structure for microscopic delamination prior to launch.
examples.zh: 航太檢驗技術員在發射前使用超音波探傷儀，逐一寸寸細檢防熱盾基座是否存在奈米級的分層剝離缺陷。

words.definition: 恐怖七分鐘大氣進入下降著陸階段；下降

examples.en: During entry, descent, and landing, onboard computers executed complex guidance maneuvers autonomously.
examples.zh: 在生死交關的下降與著陸階段，機載電腦在毫無地面干預下自主完成了所有複雜減速動作。

examples.en: The supersonic parachute deployed precisely during the descent phase to brake the capsule’s speed.
examples.zh: 超音速減速降落傘在狂暴的下降階段精準彈射開傘，在幾秒鐘內將乘員艙的速度由數馬赫急遽煞停。

examples.en: Radar altimeters tracked the descent trajectory relative to the canyon floor with millisecond accuracy.
examples.zh: 高頻都卜勒雷達高度計以毫秒級的超高採樣率，即時追蹤下降航跡相對於峽谷盆地海床的絕對離地高度。

words.definition: 火星火箭反推空中吊車降落系統；起重機

examples.en: The revolutionary rocket-powered sky crane lowered the heavy one-ton rover onto three wheels using nylon cords.
examples.zh: 革命性的反推火箭空中吊車系統，用高強度尼龍纜繩將重達一噸的探測車穩穩垂降至地面。

examples.en: Once touchdown sensors triggered, the sky crane severed the tether cables and flew away to crash safely.
examples.zh: 當探測車輪胎觸地感測器觸發的瞬間，空中吊車瞬間炸斷釋放尼龍繫繩，隨即加大反推推力全速飛離遠方墜毀。

examples.en: Employing a hovering sky crane eliminated the need for heavy, complex deployment ramps.
examples.zh: 採用空中懸停反推吊車著陸技術，徹底免除了探測器在著陸後需要額外配置笨重、易卡死釋放跳板的難題。

words.definition: 地形相對導航精準減速反推火箭

examples.en: Pulsing hydrazine retro-rockets killed the capsule’s remaining horizontal drift seconds before landing.
examples.zh: 聯氨反推火箭在觸地前數秒密集點火脈衝，瞬間抵消了艙體最後殘留的水平漂移速度。

examples.en: Throttleable liquid retro-rockets allow lunar landers to hover gently while picking a boulder-free spot.
examples.zh: 具備大範圍推力調節能力的深低溫液體反推火箭，讓登月艙能在空中從容懸停、挑選毫無巨石的平坦著陸點。

examples.en: The landing legs absorbed the soft final impact after the retro-rockets cut off thirty centimeters above the dirt.
examples.zh: 在反推火箭引擎於離地三十公分切斷熄火後，緩衝著陸支架輕柔吸收了最後的微幅觸地動能。

words.definition: 探測漫遊車完好無損輕柔軟著陸成功；著地

examples.en: Mission engineers erupted into cheers upon confirming a flawless rover touchdown inside Jezero Crater.
examples.zh: 當確認漫遊車在傑澤羅隕石坑內完美軟著陸的訊號傳回時，地面控制中心爆發出震耳欲聾的歡呼。

examples.en: Landing telemetry confirmed smooth touchdown with all six motorized wheels resting firmly on solid rock.
examples.zh: 回傳的著陸遙測數據確認軟著陸過程萬無一失，六只全驅動輪胎已穩穩扎根在火星堅固的岩板之上。

examples.en: Achieving a pinpoint touchdown within fifty meters of the geological target validated years of simulation.
examples.zh: 達成距離核心科學目標誤差不到五十公尺的超高精度定點著陸，完美印證了團隊多年地圖比對模擬的正確。

words.definition: 任務控制中心接收著陸成功確認遙測數據

examples.en: Deep Space Network antennas picked up faint telemetry packets from the lander across 200 million kilometers.
examples.zh: 深空通訊網路的巨型天線，跨越了兩億公里浩瀚距離成功捕捉到登陸器回傳的微弱遙測數據封包。

examples.en: Analyzing incoming health telemetry verified that all internal batteries and thermal radiators were operating normally.
examples.zh: 深入解析回傳的系統健康遙測數據，確認所有內部儲能鋰電池與熱散熱器迴路運轉一切指標正常。

examples.en: Real-time telemetry dropped for two tense minutes during ionization blackout before signaling safe arrival.
examples.zh: 在穿越黑障區的兩分鐘生死關頭即時數據曾短暫中斷，隨即傳回劃破死寂的平安著陸確認信號。

words.definition: 克卜勒望遠鏡發現之系外適居帶類地行星

examples.en: Astronomers discovered a rocky terrestrial exoplanet orbiting a quiet red dwarf star just twenty light-years away.
examples.zh: 天文學家在距離地球僅二十光年的寧靜紅矮星周遭，發現了一顆岩石質地的系外行星。

examples.en: Thousands of confirmed exoplanet discoveries have proven that planetary systems are common throughout the galaxy.
examples.zh: 數千顆已獲證實的系外行星發現以鐵證宣告，行星系統在浩瀚銀河系中絕非罕見特例、而是普遍存在。

examples.en: Characterizing the atmospheric composition of this rocky exoplanet is a high-priority science target.
examples.zh: 運用太空望遠鏡全面解析這顆岩石系外行星的大氣層分子組成，是目前全球天體物理學界的第一優先科學目標。

words.definition: 凌日觀測法 (量測恆星微小遮蔽光變曲線)；過境

examples.en: Transit photometry detects planets by measuring the miniscule dip in starlight when a world crosses in front.
examples.zh: 凌日觀測法，透過測量行星橫越恆星正面時所造成的微弱恆星光度變暗來發現新世界。

examples.en: Kepler space telescope observed repeated transits to determine the precise orbital period of the twin worlds.
examples.zh: 克卜勒太空望遠鏡藉由觀測恆星週期性重複出現的凌日光變曲線，精確推算出雙行星的公轉軌道週期。

examples.en: Starlight filtering through the planet’s atmosphere during a transit carries chemical fingerprints of water and carbon.
examples.zh: 行星凌日時穿透其大氣層邊緣的恆星微光，宛如指紋般攜帶了外星世界水蒸氣、甲烷與二氧化碳的化學特徵。

words.definition: 韋伯太空望遠鏡大氣分子透射光譜分析

examples.en: Infrared transmission spectroscopy reveals signatures of carbon dioxide and water vapor on alien worlds.
examples.zh: 紅外線透射光譜分析技術，精準揭露出外星世界大氣中二氧化碳與水蒸氣的化學特徵。

examples.en: Advanced spectroscopy splits incoming starlight into millions of individual wavelengths to identify atmospheric molecules.
examples.zh: 先進色散光譜儀將收集到的恆星微光分解為數百萬個不同波長譜線，精確比對並鎖定外星大氣中的微量分子。

examples.en: By comparing pre-transit and post-transit readings, transmission spectroscopy maps clouds on giant gas planets.
examples.zh: 透過對比凌日前後兩組光譜的細微差異，透射光譜學甚至能為數百光年外的氣態巨行星繪製全球雲層分佈圖。

words.definition: 木衛二地下數十公里厚之極硬冰層外殼；地殼

examples.en: Deep drilling probes may one day melt through Europa's frozen ice crust to reach the warm salty ocean beneath.
examples.zh: 熱融鑽探探測器有朝一日將融化木衛二厚達數十公里的冰層外殼，探訪下方溫暖深邃的地下海洋。

examples.en: Cracks and red mineral streaks on the surface indicate dynamic tidal flexing within the icy crust.
examples.zh: 縱橫交錯在冰原表面的紅色礦物條紋裂隙，揭示了木星巨大潮汐引力在冰殼內部引發的劇烈地質活動。

examples.en: Radar sounders mounted on the orbital probe penetrated through the top kilometers of the frozen crust.
examples.zh: 搭載於軌道探測衛星上的穿透雷達測高儀，成功穿透並透視了冰封外殼頂層數公里深的地質結構斷面。

words.definition: 冰火山向太空噴射百公里高之水蒸氣羽流

examples.en: Enceladus ejects colossal cryovolcanic geyser plumes of salty water containing organic compounds directly into space.
examples.zh: 土衛二透過巨大冰火山向外太空噴射出高達數百公里的鹽水水蒸氣羽流，蘊含豐富有機分子。

examples.en: Flying a robotic spacecraft directly through the eruption plume samples oceanic water without touching down.
examples.zh: 引導無人科學探測飛船以數馬赫速度直接穿掠噴湧而出的水蒸氣羽流，能在無需著陸的情況下直接採樣深海海水。

examples.en: Analysis of the vapor plume confirmed the presence of methane, molecular hydrogen, and complex macromolecules.
examples.zh: 對氣體羽流的原位質譜化驗確認，冰下海洋中不僅富含甲烷與分子氫，更充斥著孕育生命前驅的複雜大分子有機物。

words.definition: 跨世代星際深空載人太空探索遠征

examples.en: Deep-space human exploration tests the ultimate limits of engineering, medicine, and human courage.
examples.zh: 載人深空太空探索，是對工程科技、太空醫學與人類勇氣終極極限的偉大考驗。

examples.en: Robotic probes serve as brave scouts, paving the way for eventual human exploration of Mars.
examples.zh: 先行出發的各型機器人探測器扮演著英勇先鋒角色，為人類最終載人登陸火星奠定堅實的探勘基石。

examples.en: International space exploration unites disparate nations under a shared quest to understand the universe.
examples.zh: 跨越國界的國際深空太空探索合作，將全球不同文明與國家緊密凝聚在一同探索宇宙奧秘的崇高追求之下。

words.definition: 人類走出地球搖籃成為多行星物種之歷史宿命

examples.en: Venturing outward to become a multi-planetary species is the grand evolutionary destiny of humanity.
examples.zh: 勇敢走出搖籃、成為跨越星際的多行星物種，是人類文明在宇宙演化長河中不可迴避的崇高宿命。

examples.en: Visionary thinkers argue that Earth is merely the cradle of civilization, but one cannot remain in the cradle forever.
examples.zh: 具備遠見的先驅思想家深刻指出：地球不過是孕育人類文明最初的搖籃，但人類絕不可能永遠滯留在搖籃之中。

examples.en: Building self-sustaining cities across the solar system fulfills our cosmic evolutionary destiny.
examples.zh: 在整個太陽系各大行星上建立自給自足的永續城市，正是引領我們文明邁向星際演化的崇高宇宙宿命。

words.definition: 跨世代科學家克服萬難之堅毅不拔執著

examples.en: Landing rovers on distant worlds succeeds only through decades of tireless scientific persistence and grit.
examples.zh: 在億萬里外的外星世界成功著陸漫遊車，全憑數代科學家數十年如一日、永不言棄的堅毅執著。

examples.en: The engineers' relentless persistence overcame hundreds of software anomalies during flight testing.
examples.zh: 航太工程師團隊百折不撓的堅毅執著，在無數個通宵達旦的飛行測試中成功排除了數百道複雜軟硬體異常。

examples.en: Exploring the cosmos demands generational persistence, as journeys to outer planets span decades.
examples.zh: 探索深邃太陽系與浩瀚群星需要跨世代的持久執著，因為航向外行星邊疆的單趟遠航往往需要耗費數十年歲月。

words.definition: 凝望深空千億星系由衷生起之無窮驚嘆

examples.en: Gazing at high-resolution deep field images of baby galaxies fills the human soul with boundless wonder.
examples.zh: 當凝視著深空望遠鏡拍下百億光年外的原始星系深空影像時，人類的心靈深處被無窮無盡的驚嘆與敬畏所包圍。

examples.en: Childhood wonder about twinkling night stars inspired her to dedicate her life to astrophysics.
examples.zh: 童年仰望夜空中璀璨繁星所萌生的純真驚嘆與好奇，激勵了她毅然將畢生精力奉獻給天體物理學研究。

examples.en: Standing under a pitch-black desert sky admiring the glowing Milky Way evokes deep, timeless wonder.
examples.zh: 佇立在萬籟俱寂的高山荒漠夜空下凝望波瀾壯闊的銀河光帶，心中湧現出跨越古今、歷久彌新的崇高驚嘆。

words.definition: 揚帆啟航駛向群星璀璨之星際宇宙的

examples.en: Giant laser-driven light sails may soon propel miniature robotic probes on humankind's first interstellar voyage.
examples.zh: 巨型雷射光帆將推動微型晶片探測器，展開人類文明歷史上第一場航向半人馬座南門二的星際遠航。

examples.en: Voyager 1 crossed the heliopause into the undisturbed cold void of interstellar space.
examples.zh: 航海家一號探測器正式衝出太陽圈頂層頂點邊界，昂首駛入亙古未受擾動的冰冷星際空間。

examples.en: Designing communications networks that span interstellar distances represents a grand technological challenge.
examples.zh: 設計建造能夠跨越數光年浩瀚星際尺度的超遠程雷射通訊網絡，構成了當前航太科技最宏偉的工程考驗。

words.definition: 在浩瀚壯麗宇宙大秩序中找到人類文明定位

examples.en: We are the cosmos conscious of itself—star stuff contemplating the beauty and meaning of the infinite universe.
examples.zh: 我們是由星塵凝聚而成、具備意識的浩瀚宇宙一部分，生生不息探索著無限宇宙的美麗與意義。

examples.en: The majestic laws of the cosmos operate on scales of billions of light-years and billions of centuries.
examples.zh: 宇宙莊嚴宏偉的物理大秩序定律，在數百億光年的空間跨度與數百億年的時間長河中沉穩運轉生息。

examples.en: Pondering the silent expanse of the cosmos inspires humility, unity, and deep peace within our fragile world.
examples.zh: 靜靜思索浩瀚宇宙無聲的永恆廣袤，為我們脆弱紛爭的塵世世界注入了由衷的謙卑、團結與深沉的寧靜。
